text: Naji Marshall has 17 points off the bench. DAL winning the 3PT line 36-12.  Mavs are within 2 of the Spurs' 19-point lead.  DAL going under on picks and SA struggling from 3PT, shooting 4/30 as a team

Max Strus comes in settling things down yet again. Heat had cut lead to six, but then Strus hits a couple of 3s  Then Kobe Sanders punishes paltry Heat transition defense by putting back Isaiah Jackson miss after Klay Thompson missed open 3  Timeout Heat, 4:20 left in 3rd quarter LA leads 83-71
Heat in bonus last 2:08 of third quarter
The Mavs have erased the Spurs' 19-point lead.  DAL by 3
Like Heat after first quarter Clippers lead by nine after third quarter  87-78 LA lead, with Hachimura stuck on 17 points (6/12 FGs)  15-2 Clippers advantage on fast break
Max Strus is in foul trouble
Wemby goes 1/2 from the foul line. He's got 52 points.  Spurs take the 112-111 lead with 24.2 seconds left  Marshall 22 pts off the bench for DAL
Wemby has 51 points after the putback.  After both teams struggle on offense, Wemby gets to the foul line again

After two misses from three from Wemby and Fox, Spurs go Fox/Wemby P&R and get the and-1 opp.  Wemby has 47 points. He went 18/18 from the FT line before missing his first FT of the night.  Spurs by 3, 3:13 left
Harper's up to 21 points.  By my count, he has 16 paint points.  He has so many creative ways of getting to the rim
38% of the Spurs' games have gone to crunch time.  The Spurs enter 1-1 in crunch time.  Wemby with 45 points after getting his first three to fall
Clippers with no buckets in first 2:49 of fourth quarter and Heat are walking them down  8-2 Heat run cuts LA lead to 89-86 with 911 🚨left in regulation
Wemby ends the night with:  52 PTS, 24 REB, 8 BLK, 2 STL, 2 AST, 1 TOV in ONLY 34 MINUTES

The Spurs hold on in crunch time to defeat Dallas by 1.  SA forced Kyrie into a contested fading mid-ranger.  The Spurs improve to...  ...6-2 overall ...4-2 at home ...6-2 vs the West ...2-0 vs DAL ...2-1 in crunch time
